## Section: curriculum
```yml
heading: Workshop Agenda
items:
  - title: "DAY 1: Foundations of Dose Calculations"
    subtitle: "Focus: Understanding the Basics with Confidence"
    points: |
      - Units & conversions (mg, g, mcg, mL, IU)
      - Common formulas explained simply
      - Ratio & proportion made easy
      - Rounding rules & medication safety
      - Common calculation errors in practice
      Interactive Elements
      - Live quizzes on Kahoot
      - “Spot the mistake” activities
      - Case studies
      Outcome: Participants confidently perform basic dose calculations
  - title: "DAY 2: Weight-Based, Age-Based & OTC Dosing"
    subtitle: "Focus: Real-World Dosing for Adults & Children"
    points: |
      - mg/kg dosing step by step
      - Pediatric dosing & safe dose limits
      - Syrups, suspensions & drops
      - Maximum dose vs calculated dose
      OTC Dose Calculations
      - Paracetamol & ibuprofen
      - Antihistamines
      - Vitamins & supplements
      - Counseling on OTC dose safety
      Interactive Elements
      - Case scenarios (adult & pediatric)
      - Parent-counseling role play
      - Group decision-making: safe vs unsafe doses
      Outcome: Participants calculate, evaluate, and counsel safely
  - title: "DAY 3: Clinical & Hospital-Based Calculations"
    subtitle: "Focus: Applying Calculations in Practice"
    points: |
      - IV dose calculations
      - Infusion rates (mL/hr, mg/hr)
      - Dilutions & concentrations
      - Percentage solutions
      - Emergency & crash cart calculations (intro level)
      OTC–Clinical Safety Bridge
      - OTC overdose risks
      - Polypharmacy considerations
      - Documentation & double-check practices
      Interactive Elements
      - Simulated medication charts
      - Time-pressured clinical scenarios
      - Group discussion on real errors & prevention
      Outcome: Participants apply calculations safely in clinical settings
  - title: "DAY 4: Case-Based Mastery & Patient Safety"
    subtitle: "Focus: Confidence, Safety & Real-Life Judgment"
    points: |
      - Dose adjustment scenarios
      - Special populations (elderly, renal, pediatrics)
      - Medication error prevention strategies
      - Safe documentation & communication
      Final Activities
      - Mini OSCE-style stations
      - Team challenge: “Calculate & Defend Your Dose”
      - Pre- vs post-assessment comparison
      - Reflection & key takeaways
      Outcome: Participants leave confident, competent, and safety-focused
```
